# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: What!? Where in this entire ocean is the $$総本山$$ supposed to be!?
According to the map the organization prepared, this should definitely be the right area!?
Oh no! After coming this far, there is nothing we can do...!
Watch out! If you fall, you are finished!
Whew, that was some shake. I have never experienced an earthquake that big.
Raging flames are engulfing the cities of $$ソドムとゴモラ$$!!
Countless fires are rising even from the cities we passed through!
Earthquakes almost never happen; I have to write this in my $$日記$$!
Indeed, an earthquake of this magnitude is unprecedented!
This great earthquake is the very overture to ruin!!
At this very moment, all things are about to enter a great cycle of change!!
